watches.name: RICE GRAIN TECHNICAL BRACELET
watches.description: Integrated rice grain bracelet with quick micro-adjustment clasp. Crafted from high-quality 316L austenitic stainless steel, this bracelet features solid links and screw pins for enhanced durability and strength. The clasp is equipped with a quick micro-adjustment system, allowing for precise and comfortable fitting. The bracelet is already included with the Officine Tecniche AQUAS Pugnochiuso 01 and Pugnochiuso 02 models, and it is fully compatible with the Officine Tecniche AQUAS SUB and Officine Tecniche SVPER models without the need for strap adapters. Technical Specifications: Size: 22mm case to 16mm clasp Protective coating: 1200HV Quick micro-adjustment clasp Screw down pins (1.2mm screwdriver size)

The SWISS-MADE label, highlighting the Swiss provenance of a watchmaker, is a guarantee of quality and precision, it is based on criteria defined by law. At present, a federal ordinance sets the conditions for this World-renowed label. The packaging comes in a wooden box designed in Italy.
